label: HTTP Handler (API Gateway)
cargo_toml:
[package]
name = "http-handler"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[[bin]]
name = "bootstrap"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
aws-lambda-events = { version = "0.15", default-features = false, features = ["apigw"] }
lambda_runtime = "0.12"
serde_json = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
